rows.note: Use 時段 as the all-purpose noun for a period set aside for an activity such as counseling.

example.english: We have a counseling session this afternoon.
example.traditional: 我哋下晝有一個輔導時段。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 zau3 jau5 jat1 go3 fu6 dou6 si4 dyun6

rows.note: Use 工作階段 for the technical period of interaction while a user is logged in or connected.

example.english: Once the user logs out, the session ends.
example.traditional: 使用者登出後，工作階段就會結束。
example.jyutping: si2 jung6 ze2 dang1 ceot1 hau6 gung1 zok3 gaai1 dyun6 zau6 wui5 git3 cuk1

rows.note: Use 會議 for an individual official meeting of a council or other body, rather than its overall term.

example.english: The committee held a session today to discuss the new proposal.
example.traditional: 委員會今日召開會議，討論新方案。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui2 gam1 jat6 ziu6 hoi1 wui6 ji5 tou2 leon6 san1 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use 會期 for the official period or term during which a legislature, council, or similar body sits.

example.english: During this session, the Legislative Council will debate this bill.
example.traditional: 立法會喺今個會期會審議呢條法案。
example.jyutping: laap6 faat3 wui2 hai2 gam1 go3 wui6 kei4 wui5 sam2 ji5 ni1 tiu4 faat3 on3
